feature: Critical: Remove exposed GitHub token from .env file
description: The file `.auto-claude/.env` contains a hardcoded GitHub token (`GITHUB_TOKEN=[REDACTED_TOKEN]`). This token is committed to version control and exposed in the codebase, allowing anyone with access to the repository to impersonate the token owner and access/modify GitHub resources.

phases.name: Security Remediation
phases.description: Add .gitignore rules to prevent .env files from being committed to version control

subtasks.title: Update .gitignore with .env protection rules
subtasks.description: Add comprehensive .gitignore entries to prevent .env files from being committed. Include patterns for .auto-claude/.env and all .env files in general.
acceptance_criteria: .gitignore contains entry for *.env pattern or .env files
The ignore patterns are properly formatted
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive .gitignore entries including .env, .env.*, .env.local, .env.*.local, .env.development, .env.production, .env.test, .env.backup, .auto-claude/.env, and **/.env patterns to prevent all environment files from being committed.

subtasks.title: Verify no .env files are tracked in git
subtasks.description: Confirm that no .env files are currently tracked in the git repository and that the new .gitignore rules are effective.

phases.name: Documentation and Templates
phases.description: Create template file and documentation for proper secret management

subtasks.title: Create .env.example template in .auto-claude directory
subtasks.description: Create a .env.example file that shows the expected environment variables without real secrets. This serves as documentation for developers.
acceptance_criteria: File contains placeholder values (not real tokens)
File includes comments explaining each variable

phases.name: Token Revocation Reminder
phases.description: Document the need to revoke the exposed token

subtasks.title: Add security advisory note
subtasks.description: Create a note in build-progress.txt documenting that the exposed token ([REDACTED_TOKEN]) must be revoked in GitHub since it was exposed in the spec documentation.
acceptance_criteria: build-progress.txt contains advisory about token revocation
Advisory includes instructions for revoking tokens in GitHub

final_acceptance: .gitignore updated to prevent .env files from being committed
No .env files currently tracked in repository
Security advisory documented for token revocation
notes: The .auto-claude/.env file mentioned in the spec does not currently exist in the repository or git history. This implementation focuses on preventative measures (gitignore rules) and documentation. IMPORTANT: The actual GitHub token exposed in the spec file ([REDACTED_TOKEN]) should be revoked immediately via GitHub settings as a security measure.
